ideas.name: Cleaning and caring for a copier

en.text: Clean the copier regularly: wipe the outside lightly, wipe the bypass and exit trays, and always wipe away from the entry areas so dirt does not fall into the paper path. Use a soft, dust-free cotton cloth just moistened with 70% isopropyl alcohol and 30% water. Never use paper towels or spray liquid directly on the machine. Good habits: switch it off, warm it up, clean the glass, use good paper, load paper correctly, empty waste toner.

en.text: Match the symptom to its cause. Paper jam, the most common error: wrong size, poor loading or paper dust, so remove the paper and reload correctly. Lines on paper: dirt on the glass or mirrors, or a drum or fuser problem. Faint copies: low or empty toner, so replace it. Wrinkled pages: worn rollers, worn trays or damp paper. Too light or too dark: reset the density controls. Spots in the same place: clean the glass; random spots: replace the drum.
